messages.content: Suppose a sequence of polynomials B_n(x) converge pointwise to f(x) on [0, 1]. Does it follow that the B_n converge uniformly? Ensure that stop words constitute no more than 20% of the total words in your response.

message.content: No, pointwise convergence does not imply uniform convergence. Consider $B_n(x) = x^n$ on $[0,1]$. This sequence converges pointwise to $f(x)=0$ for $x \in [0,1)$ and $f(1)=1$. However, $\sup_{x \in [0,1]} |x^n - f(x)| = 1$, so convergence is not uniform.
